config.split: First2048 documents train; next256 validation; reserved test untouched. Reused exploratory validation.
config.geometry: Orthonormal coordinates of decoded16D block; same-token active occurrences; train>=64,validation>=8; global and local affine PCA rank4, neighbors32 and64 chosen by Euclidean query distance among train only.
config.null: Five independent Gaussian train/validation draws per token with empirical train mean/covariance and same counts; identical neighborhood selection. This controls adaptive locality, not every lexical or distributional confound.
config.degeneracy: Skip token clouds with train variance / mean squared norm <1e-10; report coverage.
config.posthoc_control: After first Gaussian results, add elliptical random directions scaled to each observed train/validation centered radius. This preserves radial magnitudes, not exact covariance; diagnostic only.
config.inference: Descriptive item metrics. No semantic or causal manifold claim.
